primary_recommendation.selection_basis: Highest target score WITHIN the Pareto frontier (ties broken by the route/round/experiment/candidate composite key ascending, because candidate_id repeats across rounds). No frontier member was removed by this choice.
primary_recommendation.cross_route_comparability_disclaimer: Cross-route target-score ordering is INDICATIVE ONLY. Each route normalizes its soft score against its own executable objective contract; the normalized values are not directly comparable between routes (red line 6). This ranking is used solely to pick the primary recommendation INSIDE the Pareto frontier -- it never removes any solution from the frontier, and every frontier member remains part of the delivered portfolio.

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: Wider thickness initialization bounds (60-130 nm vs 80-95 nm) with reduced robustness penalty will discover thickness distributions that better separate the visible reflection band from the NIR transmission band in a fixed 30-layer alternating stack.
design_orientation.proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica Substrate (30 layers total, alternating starting with HfO2)

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: The 30-layer configuration from Round 1 contains superior spectral degrees of freedom for dual-band dichroic performance; tightening thickness exploration bounds to ±15nm around the Round 1 best candidate [59,95,64,91,100,131,57,98,96,91,61,90,56,77,55,71,51,86,99,93,78,127,77,71,42,52,73,87,49,115] will enable fine-tuning of adjacent layer couplings without losing the high-performing global geometry, yielding best_target_score ≥ 0.95.
design_orientation.proposed_topology: 30 finite layers: alternating HfO2/SiO2 starting with HfO2 at air interface, terminating on fused silica substrate. Exact sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: Constraining inter-round thickness changes to ≤15 nm per layer will stabilize convergence near the Round 2 optimum (0.9400 score) while preventing the optimizer from escaping the verified high-performance basin that caused Round 3 regression.
design_orientation.proposed_topology: 30 finite layers with alternating HfO2/SiO2 sequence starting with HfO2 at air interface, terminating on fused silica substrate

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: Anchoring the four central cavity layers to round-2 optimal dimensions (~261.75, 392.46, 413.04, 220.73 nm) with ±25 nm bounds while fixing Bragg mirror periodicities (68.75/94.25 nm) will recover the 0.943 target score by maintaining the confirmed resonance window while allowing fine-tuning.
design_orientation.proposed_topology: 30-layer alternating stack: Air | (HfO2/SiO2)_12 | Cavity_4 | (HfO2/SiO2)_12 | Fused Silica substrate.
